text:
jamal-engineering: FYI vendor notified us this morning that HSA provider migration is scheduled for 2024-07-01. Quick q for people ops/payroll — do employee HSA balances 'move' automatically? And how does employer contribution timing work if we switch mid-payroll? Also FSA carryover rules for plan year ending 6/30
chris-peopleops: Short answers — HSA balances belong to the employee and are portable (they stay with the account). For employer deposits we generally stop contributions to old vendor and start to new one on the effective date. Payroll can do retro adjustments but needs vendor ACH + plan IDs ASAP. FSA carryover is plan-specific, usually either a carryover (max $610 last year) or a grace period; I'll confirm plan doc. :mag:
alexg-payroll: We can do off-cycle corrections for employer HSA contributions within our 60-day reconciliation window. Cutoff for making changes that hit the July payroll is typically ~June 20 (so we can reconcile and push to bank). If benefits sends new ACH + plan ID by then we can switch cleanly. If not, we'll need to stop old ACH and queue a manual deposit to employees' new accounts.
chris-peopleops: Thanks. Can you also confirm if payroll needs a mapping file format? Vendor sent CSV headers that look slightly different from our last migration.
alexg-payroll: We prefer CSV with these headers: 
```
employee_id, employee_ssn_last4, bank_routing, bank_account, account_type, contribution_amount, plan_id
```
Send sample to payroll@ and we'll validate. If fields differ we can transform but need notice.
elaine-peopleops: I'll pull the plan documents and confirm FSA carryover vs grace. Also will ask vendor for the mapping sample and ACH test file. Planning to send comms to impacted employees by EOD Friday. Draft subject: "Important: HSA vendor migration on July 1 — what to expect" — ok? :email:
jamal-engineering: That works. One more: when switching vendors, do we need new employee E-sign forms or is prior enrollment ported?
chris-peopleops: Enrollment elections are generally portable if the plan is the same, but many vendors require a short attestation or new authorization for ACH. We'll confirm with legal and vendor. If a new election form is needed we'll open an off-cycle enroll flow.
benefits-bot: Helpful KB links: HSA portability FAQ: https://kb.redwood.com/hsa-portability  |  Payroll migration checklist: https://kb.redwood.com/benefits/payroll-migration-checklist
elaine-peopleops: Action items: 1) I'll confirm FSA carryover limit in plan docs and post here (ETA 6/18). 2) Vendor to share ACH + sample CSV by 6/17. 3) Payroll to confirm cutoffs and off-cycle process (alexg). 4) Draft employee comms by EOD Fri (I'll post here).
alexg-payroll: Confirmed — will do CSV validation on receipt and flag any missing fields. Also confirm off-cycle adj window for reporting.
jamal-engineering: Thanks all — ping me if you want engineering to help generate sample mapping or do a dry run with test ACH values. :thumbsup:
